C0593.title: Nanjing Qinhuai District Hotel Strikethrough Price Fraud Case
C0593.summary: In April 2024, market regulators in the Nanjing metropolitan area jointly released typical pricing violation cases. A hotel in Nanjing's Qinhuai District used strikethrough prices on a room-booking page for promotions but could not prove that the comparison prices were truthful and supported. Qinhuai District market regulators found this constituted misleading pricing to induce transactions, ordered correction, and imposed a RMB 5,000 fine.
